posts.author: Buuboo
posts.body:
Hi! I’ve wanted people to get to know me for quite a bit now and I thought that making a video wouldn’t be worth it, so I thought this would be a good way!
My name is
Buu
, I am an RPG maker game dev, content creator on Youtube (@LyricistBuu), and a self-taught video editor for 3 years! Lately, I’ve been focusing on my Roguelike ARPG game, “Eternal Dungeons Shadows Of Fate” (EDSOF)
I'm looking into building a small community (I'm not getting my hopes too high on becoming popular) and right now I plan on learning pixel art so that I can stop using the official RTP and become a bit more original
, although YouTube was my all time dream (that I’ve technically already achieved) im far from being the game dev that I’ve wanted to be in my peanut brain, I haven’t given up give up
I am a sole developer and I’ve been using RPG Maker since September of 2023, my first RM engine was XP, but I switched to MZ about 8 months ago (Edit: 6-7months ago), my first project was “Warrior’s Gem Adventure” I started working on a sequel for it, but it currently is on hold
Eternal Dungeons is my first step into ARPG, and I do monthly updates on it
I am quite active on Game Jolt, Discord (@iambuuboo), and Twitter (@TheBuuBoo) if you’d like to contact me for anything, after all, I'm just trying to meet new people
I hope you learned more from me, and if you have any questions I’d gladly answer them!
- Buu

posts.author: ZombieKidzRule
posts.body:
Welcome!
Sounds like you already have experience which is awesome! And learning something new, like pixel art, is always good.
Good luck on your projects and just remember to enjoy what you do!
